claim: sync stats show no silent truncation: every parent whose text exceeds what maxChunks windows cover is stored at exactly maxChunks chunks (the cap the engine counts in parentsTruncatedByMaxChunks and logs per tick), none below or above the cap, none unchunked
method: For each text_chunks surface in the live registry: coveredChars = size + (maxChunks-1)*(size-overlap); cross-tab each eligible parent length(textSql) against coveredChars and its stored chunk count against maxChunks. at_cap_within_covered counts parents at the cap whose raw text fits (header text and window snapping add windows); it is not truncation.

sessionTurns.note: turns are capped at 8,000 characters at ingest, so no session turn can reach the 16-window cap; truncation by maxChunks is impossible on this surface (SQL: max(length(text)) over harness_shared.session_turns; max chunk count per turn key over session_turn_chunks)

loggedByBgHost.note: per-tick counts of parents re-synced in that window, not a census; operator_turns and work_items logged no truncating re-sync in the window
